use_case: Dam-safety sensor anomaly detection: the remote monitoring service's AI add-on flags unusual patterns in headwater and tailwater levels, the 4 automated uplift piezometers, and the automated seepage weir for review by staff
vendor_or_model: Remote monitoring service vendor (machine learning anomaly detection add-on, vendor SaaS; trained by the vendor, tuned on the company's own 2019-2026 readings)
data_categories: Dam safety instrument readings and levels sent one way every minute; no personal information; alerts are Internal, and any alert describing a failure mode is handled as Restricted (POL-04)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. Alerts go to the on-duty or on-call operator-mechanic, who checks the instrument and records a disposition; the Plant Superintendent decides any action, 18 CFR 12.10 report, or EAP step. Daily readings, trigger-point checks, and the consulting engineer's quarterly trend review continue unchanged. AI output never goes to the control system
applicable_laws: 18 CFR 12.10(a) and 12.3(b)(4)(viii) (unusual instrumentation readings must be reported; AI output does not change the duty); 18 CFR 12.51 (instrumentation satisfactory to the Regional Engineer); FERC Security Program Rev. 3A 3.2 (trigger points for action); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Free trial since 2026-05-04; approved with conditions 2026-08-31; paid subscription only after the contract clause is signed

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters, procedures, and reports
data_categories: Risk of CEII-type documents, control system details, or employee personal information being pasted
human_in_the_loop: Staff write and approve every output; no connection to the HPCDMS or the restricted folder
applicable_laws: CEII handling (POL-04; 18 CFR 388.113 for CEII filed with FERC); FERC Security Program Rev. 3A 3.2 (OPSEC); Fla. Stat. 501.171 if employee personal information leaks
status: Allowed only for general drafting with Public information; prohibited for Internal and Restricted information (POL-04 4.6; POL-02 C.2)
